Alex Paulsen.note: Paulsen is goalkeeper cover for New Zealand. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Alex Paulsen.noteZh: 他是New Zealand门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Alex Rufer.note: Rufer gives New Zealand a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Alex Rufer.noteZh: 他是New Zealand的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Ben Old.note: Old gives New Zealand a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Ben Old.noteZh: 他是New Zealand的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Ben Waine.note: Waine is an attacking change-up for New Zealand. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Ben Waine.noteZh: 他是New Zealand的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Callan Elliot.note: Elliot gives New Zealand another trusted body for the awkward minutes. One clean decision can keep the match from tilting.
Callan Elliot.noteZh: 他是New Zealand赛事深度的一部分。压力下还能让简单选择出现，这就是这张卡的意义。

Chris Wood.note: Wood has been a provider for New Zealand, creating goals against IR Iran. His best moments come when he plays the pass before the defense is ready.
Chris Wood.noteZh: 他这届赛事的价值在于供给New Zealand的进攻。他能在防线移动还没完成时看见跑动。

Elijah Just.note: Just has been one of New Zealand's real scoring stories, with goals against IR Iran and Belgium. His danger is arriving before defenders have finished sorting the first problem.
Elijah Just.noteZh: 他已经多次为New Zealand把机会变成进球。看他需要的空间有多小。

Finn Surman.note: Surman's World Cup has already included a goal against Egypt. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Finn Surman.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Francis de Vries.note: De Vries offers left-side balance, useful for early service and steady defensive width.
Francis de Vries.noteZh: 德弗里斯提供左侧平衡，适合早传和稳定的防守宽度。

Francis De Vries.note: Vries is the kind of defender New Zealand can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Francis De Vries.noteZh: 他是New Zealand艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Jesse Randall.note: Randall is the forward New Zealand can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Jesse Randall.noteZh: 他给New Zealand替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Joe Bell.note: Bell is a tempo player for New Zealand. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Joe Bell.noteZh: 他让New Zealand在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Kosta Barbarouses.note: Barbarouses gives New Zealand a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Kosta Barbarouses.noteZh: 他是New Zealand在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Lachlan Bayliss.note: Bayliss gives New Zealand a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Lachlan Bayliss.noteZh: 他是New Zealand的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Liberato Cacace.note: Cacace gives New Zealand one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Liberato Cacace.noteZh: 他是New Zealand无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Logan Rogerson.note: Rogerson is the forward New Zealand can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Logan Rogerson.noteZh: 他给New Zealand替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Marko Stamenic.note: Stamenic gives New Zealand structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Marko Stamenic.noteZh: 他给New Zealand控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Max Crocombe.note: Crocombe is the last voice in New Zealand's defensive shape. When pressure sticks, his job is to make the next action feel simple.
Max Crocombe.noteZh: 他承担了New Zealand的门将时间。重点是稳手、清楚开球，以及让身前后卫不用慌。

Callum McCowatt.note: McCowatt is the forward New Zealand can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Callum McCowatt.noteZh: 他给New Zealand替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Michael Boxall.note: Boxall gives New Zealand defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Michael Boxall.noteZh: 他是New Zealand后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Michael Woud.note: Woud sits behind the starter for New Zealand, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Michael Woud.noteZh: 他给New Zealand保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Nando Pijnaker.note: Pijnaker is part of New Zealand's tournament depth. His card is about making the simple play feel available under pressure.
Nando Pijnaker.noteZh: 他是New Zealand赛事深度的一部分。压力下还能让简单选择出现，这就是这张卡的意义。

Ryan Thomas.note: Thomas matters for New Zealand when possession reaches crowded areas. He is there to turn a small opening into a real choice.
Ryan Thomas.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对New Zealand来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Sarpreet Singh.note: Singh is a tempo player for New Zealand. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Sarpreet Singh.noteZh: 他让New Zealand在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Tim Payne.summary: Tim Payne is a New Zealand right-back from Wellington Phoenix who gives the national team right-back reliability, wide defending, and overlap support.
Tim Payne.note: Payne has one tournament assist in the bank for New Zealand. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Tim Payne.noteZh: 他已经帮New Zealand制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Tommy Smith.summary: Tommy Smith is a New Zealand centre-back from Auckland FC who gives the national team experience, aerial duels, and back-line organization.
Tommy Smith.note: Smith is defensive cover for New Zealand's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Tommy Smith.noteZh: 他是New Zealand在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Tyler Bindon.note: Bindon is the kind of defender New Zealand can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Tyler Bindon.noteZh: 他是New Zealand艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。
